metadata.title: Relaxation near supermassive black holes driven by nuclear spiral arms: anisotropic hypervelocity stars, S-stars and tidal disruption events

notes: No individual stars are identified. HVSs and S-stars are discussed only as populations and synthetic binary models (e.g., T:p14-b12 and T:p17-b10); the paper does not select or follow up any specific Galactic unbound star.
